responsibility: Contains the primary RTL machine description for VAX instruction selection and assembly output. It defines the target unspec codes, hard-register constants, mode iterators and substitutions, includes the VAX constraint and predicate tables, and supplies the bulk of define_insn/define_expand/define_split patterns for integer, floating-point, address, branch, stack, block, and special instructions, including condition-code-setting variants, instruction-stream synchronization, nonlocal goto handling, and inclusion of the separate builtin patterns.
same_name_distinction: Among the same-name VAX files, this is the machine description source that encodes RTL instruction patterns, mode iterators, unspec values, and expand/split rules used for instruction selection and assembly emission. It differs from vax.cc’s C++ hook implementations, vax.h’s target macros, and vax.opt’s option declarations.
